markdown.markdown:
A spatial decision-support framework for assessing urban microclimates and thermal exposure to identify priority locations for blue-green infrastructure interventions. ## Project Deliverables ### Interactive Spatial Map ```{r} #| echo: false #| message: false #| warning: false library(sf) library(leaflet) library(htmlwidgets) # 1. Read GeoJSON and transform CRS to WGS84 for Leaflet malmo <- st_read("data/CoolNet.geojson", quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(crs = 4326) # 2. Define color palettes pal_mcda <- colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = malmo$MCDA.Score) pal_uhi <- colorNumeric("Reds", domain = malmo$UHI_mean) pal_ndvi <- colorNumeric("Greens", domain = malmo$NVDI_mean) pal_nbdi <- colorNumeric("YlOrBr", domain = malmo$NBDI_mean) pal_inc <- colorNumeric("Blues", domain = malmo$Income) pal_water <- colorNumeric("PuBu", domain = malmo$Dist_Water) # 3. Build Leaflet Map leaflet(malmo) %>% addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>% # Layer 1: MCDA Priority Score addPolygons( group = "MCDA Priority Score", fillColor = ~pal_mcda(MCDA.Score), weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.75, highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#444", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE), label = ~paste0("DeSO: ", desokod, " | MCDA: ", sprintf("%.3f", MCDA.Score)), popup = ~paste0( "DeSO Code: ", desokod, "
", "
", "MCDA Score: ", sprintf("%.3f", MCDA.Score), "
", "NVDI_mean: ", sprintf("%.3f", NVDI_mean), " (Norm: ", sprintf("%.3f", nvdi.norm.), ")
", "NBDI_mean: ", sprintf("%.3f", NBDI_mean), " (Norm: ", sprintf("%.3f", nbdi.norm), ")
", "Income: ", sprintf("%.2f", Income), " (Norm: ", sprintf("%.3f", income.norm), ")
", "UHI_mean: ", sprintf("%.2f", UHI_mean), " °C
", "Dist_Water: ", sprintf("%.1f", Dist_Water), " m" ) ) %>% # Layer 2: UHI Intensity addPolygons( group = "UHI Intensity (°C)", fillColor = ~pal_uhi(UHI_mean), weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.75, highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#444", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE), label = ~paste0("DeSO: ", desokod, " | UHI: ", sprintf("%.2f", UHI_mean), " °C"), popup = ~paste0("DeSO Code: ", desokod, "
UHI Mean: ", sprintf("%.2f", UHI_mean), " °C") ) %>% # Layer 3: Vegetation (NDVI) addPolygons( group = "Vegetation (NDVI)", fillColor = ~pal_ndvi(NVDI_mean), weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.75, highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#444", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE), label = ~paste0("DeSO: ", desokod, " | NDVI: ", sprintf("%.3f", NVDI_mean)), popup = ~paste0("DeSO Code: ", desokod, "
NDVI Mean: ", sprintf("%.3f", NVDI_mean)) ) %>% # Layer 4: Built Index (NBDI) addPolygons( group = "Built Index (NBDI)", fillColor = ~pal_nbdi(NBDI_mean), weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.75, highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#444", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE), label = ~paste0("DeSO: ", desokod, " | NBDI: ", sprintf("%.3f", NBDI_mean)), popup = ~paste0("DeSO Code: ", desokod, "
NBDI Mean: ", sprintf("%.3f", NBDI_mean)) ) %>% # Layer 5: Income Level addPolygons( group = "Income Level", fillColor = ~pal_inc(Income), weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.75, highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#444", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE), label = ~paste0("DeSO: ", desokod, " | Income: ", sprintf("%.0f", Income)), popup = ~paste0("DeSO Code: ", desokod, "
Income: ", sprintf("%.2f", Income)) ) %>% # Layer 6: Distance to Water addPolygons( group = "Dist. to Water (m)", fillColor = ~pal_water(Dist_Water), weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.75, highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#444", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE), label = ~paste0("DeSO: ", desokod, " | Dist. Water: ", sprintf("%.1f", Dist_Water), " m"), popup = ~paste0("DeSO Code: ", desokod, "
Dist. Water: ", sprintf("%.1f", Dist_Water), " m") ) %>% # Add Legends (Each marked with a unique class name) addLegend(pal = pal_mcda, values = ~MCDA.Score, opacity = 0.8, title = "MCDA Score", position = "bottomright", className = "info legend leg-mcda") %>% addLegend(pal = pal_uhi, values = ~UHI_mean, opacity = 0.8, title = "UHI (°C)", position = "bottomright", className = "info legend leg-uhi") %>% addLegend(pal = pal_ndvi, values = ~NVDI_mean, opacity = 0.8, title = "NDVI", position = "bottomright", className = "info legend leg-ndvi") %>% addLegend(pal = pal_nbdi, values = ~NBDI_mean, opacity = 0.8, title = "NBDI", position = "bottomright", className = "info legend leg-nbdi") %>% addLegend(pal = pal_inc, values = ~Income, opacity = 0.8, title = "Income", position = "bottomright", className = "info legend leg-inc") %>% addLegend(pal = pal_water, values = ~Dist_Water, opacity = 0.8, title = "Dist. Water", position = "bottomright", className = "info legend leg-water") %>% # Layer Controls Menu addLayersControl( baseGroups = c("MCDA Priority Score", "UHI Intensity (°C)", "Vegetation (NDVI)", "Built Index (NBDI)", "Income Level", "Dist. to Water (m)"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE) ) %>% # JavaScript to hide all inactive legends and show only the active one htmlwidgets::onRender(" function(el, x) { var map = this; var legendClassMap = { 'MCDA Priority Score': 'leg-mcda', 'UHI Intensity (°C)': 'leg-uhi', 'Vegetation (NDVI)': 'leg-ndvi', 'Built Index (NBDI)': 'leg-nbdi', 'Income Level': 'leg-inc', 'Dist. to Water (m)': 'leg-water' }; function syncLegends(layerName) { // Hide all legends Object.values(legendClassMap).forEach(function(cls) { var elms = document.getElementsByClassName(cls); for (var i = 0; i < elms.length; i++) { elms[i].style.display = 'none'; } }); // Show target legend var activeClass = legendClassMap[layerName]; if (activeClass) { var activeElms = document.getElementsByClassName(activeClass); for (var j = 0; j < activeElms.length; j++) { activeElms[j].style.display = 'block'; } } } // Initial state: show MCDA legend syncLegends('MCDA Priority Score'); // Listen for base layer changes map.on('baselayerchange', function(e) { syncLegends(e.name); }); } ") ``` ### Presentation Slide Deck [Download Presentation PDF](assets/presentation.pdf){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}
